meta.name: writing-statuslines
meta.description: Writes Claude Code status line scripts. Use when creating, customizing, or debugging statusline configurations.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 定制 Claude Code 的状态行脚本
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你想要定制 Claude Code 的状态行显示。
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to customize the status bar in Claude Code.

howto.what: 装上此技能后，Claude 能编写 Claude Code 状态行脚本，在界面底部显示模型、成本、上下文窗口等实时信息，每次对话消息变化时更新（最多每300毫秒一次），脚本只输出一行到标准输出。
howto.when: 当用户需要创建、自定义或调试 Claude Code 的状态行配置时触发，如在 settings.json 中设置并编写脚本。

say.text: 写一个 Bash 脚本显示当前模型和会话成本。
say.note: Claude 会生成一个可执行的状态行脚本。

say.text: 帮我调试状态行，它不显示上下文百分比。
say.note: Claude 会检查脚本并按 JSON 输入修正。

say.text: 用 Python 写状态行，显示工作目录和剩余上下文百分比。
say.note: Claude 会输出一个 Python 脚本作为状态行。

howto.what_en: After installing this skill, Claude can write Claude Code status line scripts that display real-time info like model, cost, and context window usage at the bottom of the interface. It updates on conversation message changes (max every 300ms) and outputs exactly one line to stdout.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user wants to create, customize, or debug Claude Code status line configurations, such as setting up in settings.json and writing the script.

say_en.text: Write a Bash script to show current model and session cost.
say_en.note: Claude generates an executable status line script.

say_en.text: Debug my status line, it doesn't show context percentage.
say_en.note: Claude inspects the script and fixes according to JSON input.

say_en.text: Write a Python status line showing working dir and remaining context %.
say_en.note: Claude outputs a Python script as the status line.
